page.title: It’s time to print, sign, and mail your federal tax return.

div.h2: It’s time to print, sign, and mail your federal tax return.
div.p: All of the information you entered into Direct File is saved to your federal tax return (Form 1040, PDF). You can print your 1040, sign it, and file your taxes by mail.

p.strong: How to file a paper return

ol.li: Download and print your federal tax return (Form 1040, PDF)
Sign and date your return in the Sign Here section on Form 1040, page 2
Attach any Forms W-2 to the front of Form 1040
Include Schedule EIC and Schedule 8812 behind Form 1040 if your tax return includes those schedules
Mail it to the IRS with or without payment. Postmark the return by to avoid interest and penalty charges

div.p: It can take up to 6 weeks to process a paper return.

fg-alert.heading: You can file your federal taxes only as a paper tax return.

p.strong: You can file your federal taxes only as a paper tax return.

fg-detail.p: You can file your taxes only as a paper tax return because you’re missing an Identity Protection PIN (IP PIN).
Paper returns can take up to 6 weeks to process.
You need an IP PIN to confirm your identity. If you have an IP PIN but can’t find it, you won’t be able to file your tax return electronically.
Try following these instructions to get your IP PIN. Once you have the IP PIN you’re looking for, add it to Direct File.
If you need assistance, chat with customer support.
